answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond and earn a work history before it can make large trades. A hollow identity with no bond and no record is limited to tiny, rate-limited transactions, so it cannot sway prices or votes. Each new fake identity must lock fresh funds and slowly build trust, like coral growing on a reef, while an honest agent reuses one identity. A single forged credential, however shiny as an opal, fails when counterparties check its bond and history, making a Sybil flood cost far more than it can gain.
